---
title: "A tiny quantitative-finance project"
subtitle: "One synthetic price series, four Quarto deliverables"
---

This project is a small end-to-end example of a quantitative workflow:

- generate a reproducible price history;
- calculate and visualize log returns;
- estimate annualized volatility and drift;
- simulate new paths with a geometric Brownian motion (GBM); and
- compare the simulated paths with the synthetic history.

## Pick a view

- [Read the step-by-step analysis](analysis.qmd)
- [Open the dashboard](dashboard.qmd)
- [View the short slide deck](slides.qmd)
- [Open the executed notebook](notebooks/market_walkthrough.html)

All prices are generated locally from a fixed random seed. Nothing is fetched
from the internet, and the results are for demonstration only.
